en.title: Department of Transportation: 37 references to former U.S. Code sections or former act names (49 CFR, subtitle A, parts 1 to 91)
en.summary: In the CFR chapters assigned to the Department of Transportation in 49 CFR, subtitle A, parts 1 to 91, 37 references in 22 sections use a former address or name: 14 cite a section replaced by a new one when the title was enacted as positive law; 9 cite a former appendix not carried in the current Code; 7 cite a section transferred to another section; 5 cite a repealed section; 2 cite a renumbered section. Each reference was compared with release point 119-134 of the U.S. Code, which names where the old number went.
en.impact: A reader who follows these references finds a note that the section moved, or no section, instead of the text. A reference to a moved section may keep its legal effect, but the address no longer leads to the text. No effect on a decision or an amount has been established.
en.correction: The agency decides how to update each reference. Where the U.S. Code names the section the old number moved to, the evidence below gives it.
